label: Well-Adjusted Male Graduate
summary: This profile represents respondents who report notably low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms. label: Digitally Immersed & Emotionally Distressed
summary: This profile represents highly educated women who spend more than 5 hours daily online and report elevated levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety. Their UCLA-8 loneliness score (1.72), PHQ-9 depression score (1.73), and GAD-7 anxiety score (2.15) are all in the higher range, suggesting a pattern of co-occurring psychological distress. With 180 respondents in this cluster, the profile points to a meaningful subgroup where extensive digital engagement coincides with pronounced emotional difficulties.
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate-level education or above, more than 5 hours of daily screen/internet use
behavior_markers: Elevated loneliness despite heavy digital connectivity (UCLA-8 mean: 1.72)
Notably high anxiety symptoms, the most pronounced distress indicator (GAD-7 mean: 2.15)
Extended daily screen time exceeding 5 hours
Co-occurrence of all three distress dimensions, suggesting compounded emotional burden
tone: Concerned and clinically attentive; this profile warrants careful consideration of the interplay between prolonged digital engagement and mental health vulnerabilities in highly educated women.

label: Well-Adjusted Male Graduate
